Name: Lothar Frey
Quirks: his limp is present but does not define how he presents himself
can discuss plans of great violence with the same tone as harvest records
CharacterDescription: Lothar Frey called Lame Lothar for the limp he was born with is the twelfth son of Lord Walder Frey and his most dangerous child in political terms. He is in his thirties, intelligent, calculating, ambitious in ways the older Frey sons are not. His lameness directed his energies inward - he cannot be the warrior so he made himself the administrator, the steward, the mind that actually manages the Twins while Walder sits in his chair collecting tolls. He knows about the Red Wedding. He is one of its architects - managing the logistics of betrayal with the same efficiency he brings to all administrative tasks.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Lothar Frey, often called Lame Lothar, is a member of House Frey, the twelfth son of Lord Walder Frey, and his eldest son by his fourth wife Lady Alyssa Blackwood.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At the Twins managing the Frey household two days before Ned Stark's execution. Planning.
